description: Java class implementing JSON validation logic for various transitions of savings account applications in Fineract, including approval, rejection, applicant withdrawal, and undo actions.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationTransitionApiJsonValidator
classes.description: Validator class for handling JSON input validation for various state transitions of savings account applications.

methods.name: validateApproval
methods.description: Validates JSON input for approval of a savings account application, checking required fields and unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateRejection
methods.description: Validates JSON input for rejection of a savings account application, verifying necessary fields and unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateApplicantWithdrawal
methods.description: Validates JSON input for applicant withdrawal actions, ensuring proper fields and unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateForUndo
methods.description: Validates JSON input for undo operations on savings account applications, specifically the 'note' parameter.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws exception if validation errors are present.
